concept.title: About station security
concept.shortdesc: Security starts with the configuration and monitoring of each station. It involves setting up secure communication, secure email, secure user credentials, and configuring components, categories, hierarchies, and roles to grant users access only to the system objects they need to do their jobs.

section.p:
To secure a station effectively, you must both enable Niagara security features and configure your network correctly. The key areas you must configure include:
Secure communication
User authentication
Authorization management

li.p: Server identity verification prevents man-in-the-middle and spoofing attacks. To set up the digital certificates that verify server identity, use the Certificate Manager view.
Data encryption (foxs/https/platformtls) prevents eavesdropping during the actual transmission of data. You define the key size used to encrypt data transmission when you create each certificate.
Secure email communication to configure email security, you use the EmailService.

User authentication protects against unauthorized access by ensuring that only legitimate users (human users or station) can log in using or a web browser.
Use the AuthenticationService to enable the authentication schemes your station requires.
Use the UserService to assign authentication schemes and login credentials to individual users (human users or stations).
You can configure multiple authentication schemes and assign different schemes to different users.

section.title: Authorization management

li.p:
Authorization management controls what users can access and change. It does the following:
Defines which component slots, files, and histories users can access
Defines which users can modify them
Defines what actions users are allowed to perform
uses role‑based access control. Users are assigned roles, and roles map to component permissions.
To configure authorization:
Use the CategoryService to define component categories (groups of components).
Use the RoleService to assign permissions to categories.
Use the UserService to assign roles to users.

section.note: Platform security is beyond the scope of this document.
